new_target: GABA-A -> Ca2+/MAPK -> BDNF release -> TrkB-dependent CREB phosphorylation and activity-dependent neuronal program
decision_basis: Primary developing-neuron studies show that GABA-A receptor agonism activates MAPK/CREB signaling and increases BDNF expression, while TrkB blockade suppresses GABA-A receptor-induced CREB phosphorylation. This supports a bounded GABA-A-to-BDNF/TrkB/CREB functional association, but not a subtype-specific receptor assignment or direct CREB target-locus claim.
